# Shany Mo

> Product strategy and design leader who still builds. Head of Product, Strategic Ventures Incubation at BCAA. Product Executive in Residence, Mighty Capital; AI Council Contributor, Products That Count.

Shany Mo takes consequential opportunities from discovery through design, experimentation and delivery, for Series A+ companies and enterprise ventures. Engagement: leadership roles, focused projects, advisory and diligence. Contact: hello@shanymo.com.

## Pages
- [Work](https://shanymo.com/work/): four cases. BCAA fleet operations (operator console; contributed to 36% higher portfolio profitability and 33% revenue growth), Evo + Evolve rider app (customer experience walkthrough), 6ix partner-led SaaS (+48% investor conversion, −25% support demand, about 20% annual revenue growth), Grupa 0→1 marketplace (−60% talent onboarding time, +40% vetted talent network).
- [Inventory](https://shanymo.com/inventory/): every project with the business need, what Shany owned and what changed.
- [Lab](https://shanymo.com/lab/): hands-on builds: attestor, regulated-ai-pm, a research prototype.
